if: the document is a tax invoice required by section 31 and issued under rule 46 of the CGST Rules, 2017
no provision of rule 54 (tax invoice in special cases) displaces the particular
then: the tax invoice MUST carry the total value of the supply
note: One mandatory particular of rule 46(j), addressable on its own so that a missing field names the clause it breaches.

evidence.quote: total value of supply of goods or services or both;
